title: Complimenting a Nice Hand After Showdown
summaryJa: ショーダウン後、相手の良いプレイを褒めるカジュアルな会話です。ポーカーテーブルでの友好的なコミュニケーションスキルを学べます。
segments: You: Good hand there. Nice call on the river.
Opponent: Thanks! I had a feeling you were bluffing.
You: Yeah, you played it well. Well done.
Opponent: Appreciate it. You played that one smart too.
You: Thanks. Good luck with the rest of the tournament.
